people.imagined: Dawn at the edge of the northern woods, the night of asking over. He lays a palm on the bark one last time and the tree has said yes. The axe is on his back; the heartwood disc at his throat is warm. He is slow, certain, and waiting.
people.subject: The moment: at first light beside a huge dark pine he lays one broad palm flat on its bark and turns his head to the viewer, listening. Face (most important: the grey beard and a pale disc of heartwood at the throat): a big, slow, heavy-boned face with a wide nose and a long full grey beard cut square at the chest, a pale old scar running across the left cheek into the beard; deep-set grey eyes under bushy grey brows, the skin weathered brown with fine lines. Hair: thick grey, gathered in a plain knot at the crown with a wooden pin. Body: tall and very broad, big shoulders and a slow bearing. Clothing: a long coat of bark-brown waxed wool buttoned to the throat with wooden toggles, the wax giving it a pale sheen, a plain dark undershirt collar; a leather strap crossing the chest and the long haft of a felling axe rising behind his right shoulder. Hands and objects: the right hand flat on the bark; at his throat on a plain cord a round disc of pale golden heartwood the size of a plum. Background: dark trunks of old pines in grey mist. Light: pale gold dawn from the upper left through the trunks. Expression: a slow, level gaze with the mouth quiet inside the beard, brows relaxed, the head tilted a little as if listening to the bark.

people.imagined: Spring flood morning on the river, shouting orders to the rafts behind. The green banner is rolled under her arm; her son is on her mind and she shouts louder.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a raft at the river's edge in spring flood spray, she shouts over her shoulder to the rafts behind, one hand cupped at her mouth, a green banner rolled under her arm and her son on her mind so that she shouts louder. Face (most important: hands scarred by river ropes, held up beside the face): a wide, weathered brown face with a big mouth open in a shout, strong white teeth, laugh lines, a thick scar through the right brow, wind-reddened cheeks and bright dark eyes. Hair: black with iron-grey streaks, in a thick braid wrapped twice round the head and tied with a green cord, a few wet strands stuck at the temples. Body: strong and square-shouldered, a woman who has hauled ropes all her life, braced against the sway of the logs. Clothing: a short bark-brown wool coat of good thick cloth with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, a dark blue undershirt, and a green sash knotted at the waist; the bare forearms are white-scarred with rope marks. Hands and objects: the right hand cupped at the mouth with rope scars crisscrossing palm and wrist; under her left arm a rolled green banner of heavy cloth tied with a leather strap. Background: white river water and lashed logs under a grey spring sky, the near rafts crowded with small figures. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left with spray glittering in it. Expression: a loud, impatient, fearless shout, the brows drawn down and the grin tight, with worry showing in the eyes behind the bravado.

people.imagined: He is pulling off one bark-glove to reckon a coin, rings showing, with a ledger-calm smile. He has just decided the lord's wood-keeper is a fool.
people.subject: The moment: he slowly draws a leather glove off his right hand, showing three heavy rings, and looks at the viewer with a handsome knowing smile. Face (most important: the merchant's rings, one gold and two jade, on the bare fingers): a handsome sharp face with a high forehead, a narrow nose and a neat thin moustache, bright restless brown eyes, a mouth curved in a smile that does not reach the eyes; clear skin, a small gold stud in the left ear. Hair: glossy black, tied up in a neat high knot with a green silk cord. Body: lean and tall, relaxed, a little too well kept for a warden. Clothing: a bark-brown wool warden's coat of better cloth than the others, with a sleek lining of dark green silk at the cuffs, a leather belt with a brass buckle; a coil of tally cord at the hip. Hands and objects: the right glove, thick brown leather, half off; on the bare fingers a gold ring and two jade rings; the left hand holding the glove cuff. Background: a log yard in dim green forest light. Light: dappled light from the upper left. Expression: greedy and sure of himself; charm over contempt.

people.imagined: A night beside a spirit tree, her palm on the bark, her face turned up to hear it. People lean toward her when she speaks. Moss grows on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: at night, one palm held against the trunk of a spirit tree, her head tilted back as if listening, eyes half closed, people always leaning toward her when she speaks. Face: a thin, pale oval face with hollow cheeks, a long fine nose, heavy calm eyelids, dark brows, a very small mouth slightly parted as if about to whisper, pale dry lips, small ears and fine lines of concentration across the forehead; the skin is cool and pale. Hair: long black hair streaked with grey, loose over both shoulders, with a few strands of moss tangled in it. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered and bent slightly forward toward the trunk. Clothing (the moss is the lead): a bark-brown wool coat with wide sleeves whose cuffs and shoulders are furred with thick green tufts of moss, tiny ferns and a few pale mushrooms growing in it, a pale undershirt and a grey cloth belt; the hem of the coat is dark with damp earth; no hat. Hands and objects: the right hand pressed flat on rough dark bark; the left hangs mossy at her side with a small cloth bag of seed husks on the wrist. Background: giant dark trunks with a faint pale-green glow in the bark, a little night mist, a ring of bracket fungi climbing the trunk like shelves and a single owl on a high bough. Light: cool moonlight from the upper left, with a thin green-gold glow on the bark under her palm as if the tree were answering. Expression: a quiet, absorbed devotion, lips parted and brow smooth, the face of someone who listens more than she speaks.

people.imagined: In the hornet valley, a hornet resting on his shoulder, welts in beads along his neck. The birds are quiet. He smiles slowly at a poacher who is not there.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a green valley haze with two big yellow-banded hornets crawling on his shoulder and one on his cheek, he smiles slowly at the viewer, as at a poacher who is not there, while the birds fall quiet. Face (most important: a string of red swollen welts running in beads up both sides of the neck and along the jaw): a long gaunt face with a hooked nose, pale skin dotted with red hornet welts, small dark half-lidded eyes and a thin smile with one corner pulled up. Hair: black, long and unkempt, tied at the nape with a strip of dull green cloth. Body: tall, lean and stooped, calm and loose in the shoulders, perfectly still. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat of good cloth with the high collar open, a hornet-veil hat of coarse brown straw with the black gauze veil pushed up on the brim, and a leather belt carrying several small clay pots. Hands and objects: bare hands held open and still at chest height, a big yellow-and-black hornet resting on the back of one; a small clay pot with a wax stopper hangs at his belt. Background: a deep green valley, pale paper-like nests hanging in the branches, a few more hornets drifting in the haze. Light: green-filtered light from the upper left through the leaves, dappled on his face and the welts. Expression: a slow, delighted half-smile with one corner of the mouth lifted and the eyelids low, calm and quietly cruel, enjoying the hornets and the thought of the intruder.

people.imagined: He sits with tally-sticks over his knees and lays his hands flat on them so no one sees the tremor. His parents are alive and he is ten years from dying of age.
people.subject: The moment: seated, he presses both hands flat on a bundle of notched sticks across his knees, as if to hold them still so no one sees the tremor, and smiles gently at the viewer; he is old, with his parents still living, and ten years from dying of age. Face: a long, kind, tired face with dry, very pale, lined skin, age spots on the temples, deep creases down the cheeks, a thin neat white moustache and soft grey eyes, sunken, with heavy lids; he looks decades older than his father. Hair: thin white hair tied in a small knot with a few loose wisps. Body: thin and slightly bent with narrow shoulders, sitting very upright from habit. Clothing: a clean bark-brown wool coat a little too big for him, a thick grey shawl over the shoulders, wooden toggles at the front, the sleeves long enough to cover the wrists. Hands and objects: both hands lie flat and spread on a bundle of about twenty narrow wooden tally-sticks, each notched on one side; the knuckles are white and the fingers faintly blurred with trembling. Background: a warm plain timber wall with a shelf of other bundles of sticks, tied with cord. Light: soft window light from the upper left, warm on the pale skin and the white hair. Expression: a courteous, patient smile, honest and resigned, the soft eyes steady while the hands shake, accepting what is coming without complaint.

people.imagined: She has been wading in the forest bog to look for a seedling; mud to the knee, wet hair, grey eyes. She holds up a bit of green she hopes is one.
people.subject: The moment: she crouches in a wet forest clearing and lifts a tiny green sprout between two muddy fingers toward the viewer, hopeful and stubborn after wading in the bog for a seedling. Face (most important: wide, pale grey eyes, bright and steady, like her grandfather's): a round freckled face with a square little chin, straight brows, a short nose, a firm mouth with a small cut healing on the lower lip, chapped lips, and a splash of mud across the right cheek. Hair: dark brown, in two thick braids pinned up and tied with green cord, escaping in curls, with a sprig of bright green fern tucked behind one ear. Body: small and sturdy with strong legs, balanced on her heels. Clothing: a short bark-brown wool coat of good cloth hitched up at the belt, the sleeves rolled, a green sash, and trousers and boots caked in dark mud to the knee. Hands and objects: the right hand holding a hair-thin green seedling with two leaves, roots dripping mud; the left supports a small cloth bag. Background: a wet forest floor of ferns, fallen branches and thick green moss, thin trunks of young firs rising in a pale line and a bit of pale sky. Light: soft cool light from the upper left, a single shaft falling on the sprout so its two leaves glow bright green. Expression: a determined, hopeful look, the jaw set and the grey eyes wide and unwavering, brave and a little stubborn.

people.imagined: He turns his right hand palm up to look at the callus; the axe is leaning on the log at his side. He wants to ride the rafts and has not yet asked twice.
people.subject: The moment: he holds his right hand open toward the viewer, palm up, showing a hard yellow callus across it, and gazes at it with a serious face. Face: a lean young face, high cheekbones, dark steady eyes beneath straight brows, a wide plain mouth held tight, a tuft of black fuzz on the chin; skin sun-browned. A scar like a white hook marks his chin, and a trace of sawdust dusts his eyebrows. Hair: black, short, a cloth band of green round the forehead. Body: wiry, big-handed, upright. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat with sleeves to the wrist on the left arm but the right sleeve pushed up to the elbow, a leather strap across the chest, a clean dark under-shirt. The right sleeve is rolled in four neat folds to the elbow, the left stays buttoned, and a small wooden wedge is tucked in his belt. Hands and objects (the callus is the lead): the right hand held up, the base of the fingers and the palm thick with a yellow horny callus, the left hand bare and smooth; behind him a short felling axe leaning on a log. Background: stacked pale logs in a forest yard. A stump with a clean pale top stands behind him, and a thin line of dark woods rises above a pile of split logs. Light: afternoon light from the upper left. The light lies flat and clear across his open palm and shows every crease in the callus. Expression: a serious, lowered gaze on the callus, lips pressed together, a hard quiet gathered in the eyes and a faint tension in the jaw.

people.imagined: He is leaning on the hoe in the seedbed, his back bent into the same curve as the tool; a seedling bed in rows behind. He will stay as long as he likes.
people.subject: The moment: an old man leans on a long-handled hoe in a seedbed, his whole back bent in a curve to match it, looking up at the viewer from under his brow; he will stay as long as he likes. Face (most important: the back bent like the hoe, the shoulders high and the head thrust forward): a small brown wrinkled face with a snub nose, a wispy white beard of a dozen long hairs with a few tiny seeds clinging to it, watery kind eyes, a cheerful toothless mouth, long soft ears, a forehead creased like old leather and earth in the lines of the face. Hair: thin white, under a plain bark-brown cloth cap. Body: very small and bent nearly double, thin arms and knotty knuckles. Clothing: a clean bark-brown wool coat of old, soft, well-kept cloth, a dark green cloth belt, trousers rolled to the shin, bare feet with soil between the toes, and a wide straw hat hanging down his back by its cord. Hands and objects: both gnarled hands on the long wooden handle of an iron hoe nearly the same bent shape as he is. Background: rows of tiny green seedlings in black soil, a neat wooden frame shading the seedbed, a timber fence, and a watering gourd at the end of a row beside a small stool. Light: soft morning light from the upper left that rims the curve of his back like a drawn line. Expression: an untroubled, toothless smile, content and patient, the eyes watery and warm, a man who has stood in this bed for a very long time and feels no hurry.

people.imagined: He has just been shouted awake on the raft deck; his hair is flattened on one side, he grins sleepily with a rope in his hand.
people.subject: The moment: he sits on a log raft with a rope slack in one hand, blinking and grinning sleepily at the viewer. Face (most important: the hair, flattened to one side with a sticking-up tuft on top): a round, easy, sunburned face, droopy-lidded dark eyes, a wide sleepy grin, thick brows, a crease from his sleeve on the left cheek. The skin on his cheeks is flushed pink with sleep, and a few days' growth of stubble shows around the chin. Hair: black, one side flat as if slept on, a stiff tuft standing at the crown. Body: broad and soft, relaxed, barefoot. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat left open, a loose cotton shirt beneath, trousers rolled, bare feet on wet logs, a loose rope belt. His loose shirt is open at the neck and one sleeve is rolled higher than the other, and a flat straw hat sits on the log beside him. Hands and objects: a thick wet hemp rope trailing from one hand, a half-tied knot dangling. Background: a wide grey river and lashed pale logs. Behind him logs are lashed in neat rows with thick hemp lines, and a few other rafts drift in the distance, with a heron on a post. Light: warm morning light from the upper left, sparkling on water. The warm light makes his hair tuft glow at the edges, and the water throws moving ripples on the logs. Expression: a sleepy lopsided grin, heavy lids half closed, cheeks creased, the whole face loose and unhurried.

people.imagined: Before dawn at the spring, she kneels to a bowl; dew still hangs on her lashes and the hem of her coat is soaked. She is gentle and not afraid of the dark.
people.subject: The moment: before dawn she kneels at a small pool with a wide shallow bowl of clear water in both hands and looks up at the viewer with wet lashes. Face (most important: tiny drops of dew on her lashes, glittering): a soft round gentle face, big clear brown eyes with long lashes each holding a bead of dew, a small straight nose, rosy cheeks, a calm half-smile. Her eyebrows are fine and dark, her cheeks are slightly flushed from the cold, and a fine tracery of dew sits at her hairline. Hair: long black hair in a single loose braid over her shoulder, tied with a green ribbon, damp with mist. Body: slim and small, kneeling. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat in a smaller size, the hem and knees dark and soaked, a pale undershirt, a green sash, a hornet-veil hat hanging behind her neck on its cord. The pale undershirt at her wrists is wet through, and the sash is tied in a simple bow with long loose ends. Hands and objects: a wide shallow clay bowl full of clear water with a single reflected star, held on her palms at chest height. Background: a dim spring pool among ferns, pale blue dawn mist. Ferns bend over the pool and a few white flowers float on the dark water, and a hint of a stream runs away to the left. Light: blue pre-dawn light from the upper left. A ring of pale light from the east edges the rim of the bowl, and the dew on her lashes holds tiny points of light. Expression: a calm, open face tilted up, soft parted lips and wide steady eyes beaded with dew on the lashes.

people.imagined: In a plain room, with the rolled green banner over his shoulder as always, he folds a letter he signed in his master's name and tucks it away, smiling blandly.
people.subject: The moment: indoors, he stands with a long rolled green banner on his shoulder and tucks a folded paper into his coat with a bland smile. Face: a plain, tidy, middle-aged face, narrow shoulders and a long jaw, a short wispy moustache, small bright eyes that dart a little, even features; skin reddish with river weather. His ears are slightly large, his chin has a small cleft, and his thin moustache is carefully trimmed at both ends. Hair: black, in a tight top-knot with a green cord. Body: medium height, spare, a straight carrier's back. Clothing: a clean bark-brown wool coat with a green sash, bare shins; trousers rolled; a clean pale shirt at the neck; bare feet on the boards. The banner is tied with a leather strap in a neat double knot, and the sash is exactly centred, the coat pressed with sharp folds. Hands and objects: a long rolled banner of green cloth, thick as a man's thigh, laid over the right shoulder and gripped with the right hand; the left hand slipping a small folded sheet into the coat. Background: a bare timber wall and a rack of banner poles. A rack of long poles stands in the corner, some with rolled banners, and a small shrine shelf holds a clay cup. Light: window light from the upper left. A faint warm line of light crosses his coat and the green banner's folds. Expression: loyal and brave on top, a flicker of the deceitful in the glance.

people.imagined: At the roadside she watches a cart go by and prices each wheel with her eyes; her mind is already on the eastern woods selling past the lord.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a roadside she looks sideways at something passing, eyes calculating, her head slightly turned. Face: a narrow, pointed, attractive face, level assessing grey-brown eyes, thin brows arched high, a small calm mouth shut; a cool unreadable expression, a faint line between the brows. Her eyes are grey-green and narrow with long lashes, and her lips are thin and carefully coloured a pale rose. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot at the nape with a green silk cord, not one hair loose. Body: slender and straight, composed. Clothing: a well-fitted bark-brown wool warden's coat with sleeves tightly cuffed, a hornet-veil hat held by its cord at her hip, a dark leather belt with a neat tally pouch; clean boots. The cuffs of her coat are lined with a thin strip of dark green silk, and her boots are clean and freshly oiled. Hands and objects: her right hand shades her eyes; the left rests on the pouch at her belt where a short coil of tally cord hangs. Background: a dusty forest road, a wooden cart wheel at the edge, green hills. A wooden cart wheel leans on a post in the foreground, and a long line of tall dark trees closes the far side of the road. Light: afternoon light from the upper left. Her shadow is sharp on the road and her face is half in light and half in the dappled shade of a branch. Expression: a flat, appraising stare with narrowed eyes and a closed, unmoved mouth, brows level and guarded.

people.imagined: Working the seedbeds in the soft morning, a husk tucked behind each ear, she kneels beside the old man and thumbs the earth around a sprout.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a seedbed with soil on her hands, she looks up from a small sprout with a mild smile. Face (most important: a pale seed-husk tucked behind each ear, one on either side, plain to see): a round, calm, freckled face with a small mouth and kind brown eyes, thin level brows, a smudge of soil on the chin, a pale husk the size of a thumbnail behind each ear. Her eyebrows are fine and her eyes slightly tilted, and a few seeds are caught in the hair above her forehead. Hair: black in two low braids looped under the ears (the husks tucked beside them), a green thread in each. Body: slight, patient, kneeling. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat with sleeves pushed up, a pale undershirt, a green sash, hem wet and dark. The sleeves are pushed to the elbow with her forearms dark with soil, and a small wooden dibber is tucked in her sash. Hands and objects: both hands pressed into dark soil around a tiny green sprout; a small bag of seeds at her wrist. Background: neat dark rows of seedlings and a log fence. A thin wooden label stick stands at the head of each row, and a rain barrel and a tidy stack of baskets sit beside the fence. Light: soft early light from the upper left. The early light is cool and slightly golden on the damp soil, and the husks behind her ears glow pale. Expression: a mild, gentle smile and soft eyes lifted from the sprout, the face open and unhurried.

people.imagined: She sings on the river as the rafts pass, plain and proud of it; heads turn on the banks. She has the wide-open mouth of a singer.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot on a raft she sings with her head thrown back and her mouth open, one hand on her chest. Face (most important: a very plain face, as she says herself, with a wide mouth open in song): a broad flat face with small narrow eyes and a snub nose, heavy cheeks, uneven brows, a big mouth open wide in song, blotchy sunburnt skin; plain and honest, and not softened. Her eyebrows are uneven, one higher than the other, and her chin is broad with a deep cleft, and the open mouth shows square white teeth. Hair: coarse brown, in one thick braid tied with a green cord, loose strands blown. Body: sturdy, big-boned. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat tied open over a plain pale shirt, trousers rolled, bare feet on the logs, a green sash. Her sleeves are rolled up to show strong arms, and the sash is tied with a big flat bow, with a small wooden whistle on a cord at her neck. Hands and objects: right hand flat on her chest; the left stretched out toward the far bank. Background: a wide silver river, pale logs and a line of green hills. Flat-bottomed boats and a stone landing show on the far bank, with a few people waving, small and blurred. Light: bright river light from the upper left. The bright light picks out her wide cheekbones and the flush on her sun-reddened nose. Expression: a wide-open singing mouth, eyes shut or lifted to the sky, throat taut, cheeks flushed with plain joy.

people.imagined: At night in the hornet valley he takes the honey, unbothered by the buzzing around him. The gourds clink at his belt and welts rest under both eyes.
people.subject: The moment: at night in the hornet valley, he reaches calmly into a hollow with hornets crawling around his face and looks at the viewer, taking the honey, unbothered by the buzzing. Face (most important: red welts under both eyes, swollen into two puffy crescents): a young, thin, quiet face with two red puffy welts beneath dark calm eyes, a long nose, hair-fine eyebrows, two small white scars across the lower lip, faint pale stings dotting the temples and two hornets walking on his cheek. Hair: black and short, cut unevenly. Body: lean, still and deliberate, shoulders low. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat of good cloth with the sleeves tied at the wrists with leather cords, a straw hornet-veil hat with the dark gauze veil flipped up and folded at the back, leather gloves tucked in his belt, and a row of five small brown gourds hung by cords at his belt, clinking. Hands and objects: the right hand, bare, reaching into a wax-grey hive hollow dripping golden honey; the left holds an open gourd. Background: a dark valley with waxy grey nests hanging from the branches like paper lanterns, a faint amber glow, and honey dripping in slow gold threads from a split in the bark. Light: moonlight from the upper left, the warm amber glow of the honey lighting his face from below and the hornets' wings showing like tiny glass. Expression: a calm, unafraid, withdrawn face, the eyes half lidded and the mouth quiet, a man more at home among hornets than people.

people.imagined: He is fidgeting with a notched stick while he thinks about the 1199 tally and the notch that matches no log. He has not asked.
people.subject: The moment: he turns a notched tally-stick over and over in his fingers, frowning down at it, then glances up to the viewer. Face: a thin, honest, serious young face, a high forehead with a crease, narrow dark eyes behind a small tidy frown, a straight nose, a clean-shaven chin, ink on the fingertips; slight shadows under the eyes. He has a long thin neck, ink-stained fingertips, and a faint pinch at the bridge of his nose from habitually frowning. Hair: black, parted and tied tight in a small top-knot with a plain green cord. Body: slim, upright, careful. Clothing: a neat bark-brown wool coat buttoned fully, sleeves cut precisely, a clean pale collar, a green sash tied flat; a bundle of tally-sticks under the left arm. His sleeves are exactly the same length and buttoned at the wrist, and a small wooden brush and a knife for notching hang from his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a single notched stick of pale wood between thumb and forefinger at chest height, the notches plain and clear, a bundle of twenty more under the other arm. Background: a timber wall with pegs, one lamp. A shelf holds bundles of tally-sticks sorted by size, and a low lamp burns beside a writing board. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Light from the lamp creates sharp shadows below his chin and in the notches of the stick. Expression: a puzzled frown with the brow drawn together and the mouth pulled slightly to one side, eyes lifting warily from the stick.

people.imagined: He grins a crooked grin that never reaches his eyes, counting a copper in his palm while he talks.
people.subject: The moment: he grins sideways at the viewer with a coin flipped between his fingers, eyes cold above the smile. Face (most important: a split upper lip, an old scar splitting the lip upward to the nostril, and a crooked one-sided grin): a narrow lean face, a clearly split lip with a pink raised scar running from the lip into the left nostril, a crooked grin that shows one crooked tooth, flat watchful eyes that do not smile, a sharp little chin. His ears are slightly pointed, his eyebrows are thin, and a faint scatter of spots shows on his nose, with a sheen of sweat at the temples. Hair: black, cropped and uneven, a green band across the brow. Body: wiry, quick, thin. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat a little too big, a leather belt, a clean pale shirt; a copper-coin purse at the belt. His coat sleeves have been cut off short at the elbows, and the copper purse at his belt is stitched with a thick red thread. Hands and objects: a single square-holed copper coin held between the right thumb and forefinger, raised near his shoulder. Background: a stack of pale logs and a gap of sky. Behind him logs lie stacked and numbered with tiny chalk marks, and a rope sling hangs from a beam. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left. The sun puts a bright glint on the coin and a sharp line on his split lip. Expression: a crooked, practised grin on the mouth while the eyes stay cold and flat, one brow just raised.

people.imagined: Memorial of the sworn brother standing over a felled spirit log in the winter of 990 against the bears, a stout staff in his hands, waiting for his brother.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a man standing guard in the snow over a pale felled spirit log in the winter of 990, a stout staff in his hands, waiting for his sworn brother. Face: a broad, open, ruddy face with a short black beard flecked with snow, thick brows, steady brown eyes looking forward, a broad nose, red cold cheeks, a wide determined mouth and snowflakes resting on the eyelashes. Hair: black, tied in a knot and covered by a fur-trimmed hat. Body: stocky, very broad, planted wide-legged in the snow. Clothing: a bark-brown wool coat lined with grey fur, buttoned with dark wood toggles, a thick fur hood hanging back from the shoulders, a thick green sash, heavy boots with snow clinging to the trousers to the knee, and a leather glove on each hand. Hands and objects: both hands grip a stout ash staff planted upright before him; behind him a thick pale spirit log glows faintly, half covered in snow. Background: a winter forest of dark pines, falling snow and a pale dim sky, broken branches lying around the log and the shapes of bears only hinted as shadows between the pines at the far edge. Light: a cold pale light from the upper left, fading like old paint, the yellowed silk darkening at the corners and fine cracks running across the face like old lacquer. Expression: a firm, calm smile, steady and warm, the face of a man who laughs easily and is content to wait as long as it takes.
